en: Black-and-white photograph of an outdoor tennis court with stepped concrete stands on two sides. A men's tennis match is in progress while a seated umpire watches from a tall metal chair. Spectators, many in light summer clothing or swimsuits, sit along the terraces. Behind the stands is a dense forest of coniferous trees. Two flagpoles rise above the trees at the left, each flying a dark flag. The scene has a mid‑20th‑century feel and appears to be a leisure or resort sports facility.
